title: mSTEB: Massively Multilingual Evaluation of LLMs on Speech and Text Tasks
reasoning: The paper introduces a new benchmark called mSTEB for evaluating Large Language Models on speech and text tasks across many languages. Its primary focus is on cross-lingual performance, coverage of low-resource languages, and multimodal capabilities. It does not include benchmarks or evaluations related to religion, faith, spiritual traditions, morals, or ethics.
